title: apparule.ledger.reconcile_requested
description: common's hourly job -> commerce, on cuelabs.requests. The ledger's provider-facing movements in the window, for commerce to compare with Paystack's transactions and transfers (system-design.md §6.4). Replaces the compacted ledger.entries topic (X-11). Key: "reconcile".

lookup.description: `window` widened on both sides. Both sides are searched over it, and only items inside `window` whose reference is missing from the other side are reported, so an item that crosses the window's edge is not a mismatch.

movements.description: Every movement recorded in `lookup` (or `window` when lookup is absent).
